text: Winamax is a French SAS (SIREN 492 155 932, RCS Paris, capital 2,547,990.25 EUR) led by its founders Alexandre Roos, président du conseil d'administration and directeur général, and Christophe Schaming, directeur général délégué; OXLEY PROPERTIES S.A sits on the board. No external controlling shareholder appears in the opened registry record.
short: Winamax is a founder-led French SAS (SIREN 492 155 932); no controlling outside shareholder found.
